text: ‘Poverty in developing countries is caused by the spread of global capitalism.’ Evaluate this view.
‘Only rich countries benefit from global migration.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘No single group controls the media.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘The media has a direct and powerful influence on human behaviour.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘Religious organisations are patriarchal.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘People are less religious today than in the past.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
